findings: Adobe MakN framing delegates vendor selection to the MakerNotes table; the wrapper alone is not vendor recognition.
The maker directory location is selected by vendor LocateIFD; offset zero is only our explicit candidate assumption.
Original-offset base correction is conditional on vendor subdirectory Base rules, not a universal extent proof.
The parser contains a JPEG-conversion header workaround; it is historical compatibility handling, not a normative safe profile.
External original MakerNote references can be missing from a converted DNG; decoder metadata extraction does not prove complete pointer closure.
next_action: Interpret any bounded candidate result only as geometry. A future private profile needs an explicit vendor identity/header grammar, base rule, complete private pointer graph, overlap partition and exact-byte vectors; ambiguous cases keep ordinary fallback.
